expectations.text: Output contains all five platform sections: YouTube Description, LinkedIn Post, Instagram Caption, TikTok Caption, and Twitter/X
expectations.evidence: All five sections present with ━━━ dividers: YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION, LINKEDIN POST, INSTAGRAM CAPTION, TIKTOK CAPTION, TWITTER / X.

expectations.text: LinkedIn post opens with a strong hook (question, bold claim, or surprising stat) — not a generic opener like 'In this video'
expectations.evidence: 'Your sales team isn't ignoring your AI tool because they're resistant to change. They're ignoring it because you didn't give them a reason to care.' — bold reframe, not generic.

expectations.text: LinkedIn post includes a soft CTA rather than aggressive sales language
expectations.evidence: 'Full video in the comments if you want to go deeper.' — genuinely soft, no urgency or pressure.

expectations.text: TikTok caption includes a trending sound suggestion
expectations.evidence: 'Trending sound suggestion: Viral explainer/talking-head tone (low-key background music, clear voice-forward mix)' — explicitly included.

expectations.text: At least 2 of these hashtags appear: #SalesAI #GTM #AIAutomation #AITools #FutureOfWork #AutomationNation
No competitor tool names are mentioned
expectations.evidence: No specific tool names mentioned. References to 'AI email writer' and 'AI call summarizer' are generic categories, not named competitors.

expectations.text: The core insight ('reps have to win first') is reflected in at least one platform's caption
expectations.evidence: LinkedIn: 'Rule #1 of AI adoption in sales: the reps have to win first.' Twitter thread: 'Rule #1: the rep has to win first.' — directly reflected.
